race.comment: Wide open edition of the Cranbourne Cup. WARNIE (2) is a deserving favourite. He did fail in this race last year with a slight query at the mile but his run in the G1 Toorak Handicap two back when fourth to Lady Shenandoah is outstanding form. Just fair at Flemington but had things against there and can bounce back. JUST FOLK (4) is racing so consistently, a (very) distant third to Autumn Glow and Ceolwulf last time. If the rain comes on Friday he'll be very well suited. AMENABLE (8) is racing very consistently and will be right there again. He slips out to 20 runs without a win now - so you wouldn't want to have your last on him - but he has built nicely for this stable and he's a good one on his day. REGAL ZEUS (6) can be up there on pace with JUST FOLK making himself hard to beat as he can.
